mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer that increases carvedilol metabolism, potentially reducing carvedilol exposure and efficacy; carvedilol may also increase eslicarbazepine levels through protein binding displacement.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; may need to increase carvedilol dose; consider alternative antiepileptic if carvedilol efficacy declines or switch to non-enzyme-inducing anticonvulsant.
